I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and how it looks are unchecked.

It follows `DESIGN.md` and the Screens rules:
- **Layout:** a 1280px `#component` on white paper, with one centered column (max 1120px). The "Notifications" heading is in Unbounded Light caps on the left, and the ink "Mark All as Read" pill (44px) is on the right.
- **List:** one bordered card holds the six notifications as 52px rows with 1px dividers. The three unread rows have an accent dot and semibold ink text. The read rows are muted. Times are right-aligned.
- **Tokens:** every colour, size and spacing value comes from a token. I copied only the tokens I use from `tokens.css` into the file's `<style>`, because it has to be self-contained. It has no JavaScript.
- **Accessibility:** unread rows carry hidden "Unread:" text for screen readers.

The Unbounded and Archivo fonts aren't bundled, since I could only use files in the folder. Without them installed, the page falls back to the system sans-serif, so the heading will look different from the intended Unbounded Light.
